we present the world’s first 100Gbit/sec 2Vpp differential voltage swing power MUX in SiGe BiC MOS technology for directly driving an ultrashort plasmonic M ZM in a silicon photonic transmitter.
a 100 Gbit/sec power multiplexer for directly driving a silicon photonic modulator is demonstrated, with a voltage swing of 2 Vpp at the speed limit (140 Gbit/s) of available measurement equipment.
we have developed a 100Gbit/ s 2Vpp power MUX in SiGe Bi CMOS technology that is suitable for directly driving a 100Gbps MZM in an integrated silicon photonic transmitter.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and optimization of the MZM driver PMUX for the integration of a 100Gbit/ s silicon photonics transmitter on a single chip.
the design and implementation of a novel silicon photonelectric process for the monolithic integration of high-speed modulators with SiGe BiCMOs multiplexers on the same chip.
the development of high-speed SiGe BiCMOs technology for the integration of high-performance optical components in silicon photonic transmitters.
